faqTitle: Before you hand over the phone.
faqQ: Do I have to change my number?
Is this a real phone call?
faqA: The planned setup keeps your existing number. You forward calls to a Malaysian JomCall number, with a verification call before going live. Telco-specific instructions still need verification.
The product is designed for BM, English, Manglish and Mandarin, including language changes during a call. Actual voice quality will be validated through the Malaysian speech benchmark.
No. This frontend uses fictional calls and text simulations. It does not access your microphone, dial a number or make a real booking.
Hosted billing will use MYR. Rates and payment provider are still being validated. Amounts in the app are sample costs, not a price offer.

stepDescriptions: We’ll use these details to shape your sample agent.
Import a fictional starting point, then make every detail yours.

Connect a sample WhatsApp channel, or come back to it after your first test.

Run a complete simulated browser call. Watch what your agent says and which tools it uses.

Try the wallet flow with fictional credit. No price offer, checkout or payment.

carrierNotes.Maxis: Check whether call forwarding is enabled for your line in the Maxis app’s add-ons. Once enabled, manage forwarding through your phone settings. Confirm the mode and charges before going live.
carrierNotes.CelcomDigi: On iPhone, find Call Forwarding in Phone settings; on Android, look in call settings. Menu paths vary by device. Confirm conditional forwarding support for missed calls with CelcomDigi.
carrierNotes.U Mobile: Use a Malaysian destination number. U Mobile states that forwarding is billed separately from bundled voice minutes. Confirm your plan’s activation method and charges with the provider.
carrierNotes.Unifi: Confirm whether your business uses Unifi Mobile or a fixed voice line. Ask Unifi support for the forwarding method supported by that specific service; this preview does not assume a shared activation code.

remaining.rateHint: Illustration: RM 0.32/minute and RM 0.05/message. Excludes numbers, provider fees and taxes. No plan is purchased here.
remaining.paygoBody: Top up when you need it, inspect every usage entry and set an automatic refill threshold in the preview.
remaining.docsTitle: From first hello to a working front desk.
remaining.docsIntro: Short guides for the decisions that matter. Every guide opens its matching workspace screen.
guideTitles: Set up and test your agent
guideBodies: Add your business, review the AI draft and test before forwarding. The preview simulates microphone, connection and forwarding outcomes.
Reserve a sample line, choose a branch and connect sample WhatsApp. Templates and channel health control which actions are available.
Connect one calendar, choose a branch and confirm an appointment. Hours, closures and conflicts are checked before saving.
Publish a workflow revision, enroll an opted-in contact, then step through it. Quiet hours and unclear outcomes stop sends.
Change business details, invite sample teammates, inspect the audit history and configure your retention policy.
Use fictional readiness states to explore first-run checks. Real credentials belong only in server environment configuration.
remaining.legalDraft: Preview document · not final service terms
remaining.legalIntro: This page describes this local fictional preview. Operator details, production providers and final policies must be completed before launch.
privacyBodies: Business settings, fictional contacts, messages, bookings and usage are saved in this browser. Do not enter real customer information or credentials.
Contacts includes consent history, do-not-contact, JSON export and local deletion. Export or delete a sample contact to see its linked records change.
No real call recordings are captured. Retention settings demonstrate a future policy; there is no audio deletion service in this preview.
The service operator must publish its identity, privacy contact, processing purposes, provider and transfer details, retention rules and rights request procedure. These are not finalized here.
termsBodies: All calls, messages, payments, access and provider checks are simulations. Local data can be lost when browser storage is cleared.
This is a demonstration workspace. Use sample names and non-deliverable emails; never add API keys, real recordings or private customer data.
Wallet top-ups, receipts and outbound delivery states represent sample events. They do not charge a bank account, send a message or reserve a real phone number.
Commercial pricing, service commitments, acceptable-use terms, payment/refund rules and governing terms require final operator review before a live launch.
remaining.branchHoursIntro: Set independent schedules and sample holiday closures for each branch. Bookings use these exact hours.
remaining.holidayHint: Choose a date to simulate a state holiday. This is not an official Malaysian holiday feed.
remaining.hoursError: Check opening times and choose a date before adding a closure.
